# isLicenseTier

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Narrows an arbitrary value to a [`LicenseTier`](license-tier.md).

Deliberately strict — this backs the "unrecognised value is a programming error" rule in the shared specification. Case-insensitive matching applies only to the `BONNIEPDF_LICENSE` environment variable, in its own reader.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
isLicenseTier(value: unknown): value is LicenseTier
```
